verdict.rationale: Grouping related chats and files into a project or space is a fair question for an AI assistant like Kimi, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a project or space feature with shared context and instructions. Kimi Code Desktop opening a local code folder is a coding-workspace feature, and the general 'memory' help topic is a different capability, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions
